title: Motorola unveils Edge 70 Plus, Watch Ultra, Swarovski Razr 70 at IFA 2026
description: At its IFA 2026 keynote today, Motorola unveiled the new Edge 70 Plus smartphone, the Watch Ultra, adorned the Razr 70 (Razr 2026 in the States) with Swarovski Crystals for its Brilliant Collection, and showed off a 25W Qi 2.2-compatible magnetic wireless charger. Motorola Edge 70 Plus Let's start with the Motorola Edge 70 Plus, the latest in a big family. The Edge 70 Plus comes in four Pantone-certified finishes - Gray Lilac, Milky Blue, Mountain View, and Sage. title: This iOS 27 feature will let you use one phone number on two iPhones
description: Apple is expected to release iOS 27 to the public shortly after its iPhone event next week. Ahead of the official rollout, we’ve got a first look at a new feature that will let users use the same phone number on two iPhones. iOS 27 will introduce a new feature called iPhone Handoff, which was only mentioned on a slide during Apple’s WWDC announcements in June. Now, a MacRumors forum member has shared additional details about the feature and how it will work. The user simulated two iPhones using Device Hub in Xcode 27 and set up the iPhone Handoff feature. According to their...

title: vivo V80 Lite arrives with 10,000mAh battery
description: As expected, vivo unveiled its V80 Lite in Malaysia, and the phone’s major selling point is its gargantuan 10,000 mAh Si-C battery. Fair warning this is a different phone from the V80 Lite that launched last week in India. Apart from the larger battery, the international V80 Lite brings a Dimensity 7300e chipset, which is fabbed on a 6nm process instead of the 4nm Dimensity 7360 Turbo found on the Indian variant. Back to the 10,000 mAh battery. According to vivo’s claims, you can expect up to 30 hours of video playback and impressive feats like 64 hours of talk time and 14 hours of...

title: Mivi One 5G's launch date and design revealed
description: Indian consumer technology brand Mivi recently announced that it will enter India's smartphone market this month with the Mivi One 5G. Now, Mivi has announced that the Mivi One 5G will launch in India on September 24. Additionally, Mivi gave us a glimpse of the Mivi One 5G's design. The smartphone's flat back panel features a vertically aligned camera island, housing two cameras of unknown resolution. The camera module also has a flash on its right side, and at the top of the phone is what appears to be the secondary mic. Mivi says the One 5G will be the only smartphone in its price...

title: TCL unveils 11" TCL Tab A1 NxtPaper tablet and a kids watch with a robotic cradle
description: TCL has brought two NxtPaper tablets and a kids smartwatch to IFA. Unlike the new TCL P80 phones, which introduced the first AMOLED-based NxtPaper displays, the tablets rely on LCD. TCL Tab A1 NxtPaper The TCL Tab A1 NxtPaper is a new 11” tablet with a NxtPaper LCD with 2.1K resolution and 90Hz refresh rate. TCL will offer the tablet on its own, but there is also a version that comes bundled with a Kids Proof case that adds protective padding, a place to stash a small stylus and a built-in carrying handle/kickstand. TCL Tab A1 NxtPaper The Tab A1 is based on the Helio G100...

title: The TCL P80 Ultra debuts the first OLED-based NxtPaper display, the P80 Pro has it too
description: TCL introduced the NxtPaper brand several years ago and since then the technology has continued to improve – and to become more central to the TCL experience. Today, the company debuts the first NxtPaper smartphone featuring an AMOLED display instead of an LCD like previous iterations. The company is launching three closely related phones today – let’s have a closer look. TCL P80 Ultra As you can tell by the name, the TCL P80 Ultra is the “no effort spared” flagship of the series. And we have to start with its display as it is its best and most unique feature. This is a 6.83” AMOLED...

title: Redmi 17 5G arrives in India with a battery upgrade
description: Xiaomi has launched the Redmi 17 5G in India with a minor upgrade over the global variant. Aside from this one change, the Indian model retains the same design and specifications as its global counterpart. The Indian variant of the Redmi 17 5G packs a 7,900mAh battery, compared to the 7,500mAh cell found in the variant that’s sold in other global markets. It supports 45W wired charging. Apart from that, the phone being sold in India is identical to its global counterpart. It’s powered by a Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset, paired with up to 8GB of RAM and 128GB of internal storage. It...

title: Samsung is on a roll - One UI 9 beta update coming to 10 more Galaxy devices
description: Samsung has expanded the One UI 9 beta rollout to 10 more devices, after releasing the Android 17-based beta update for the Galaxy S25 series (except S25 Edge) and the Galaxy S24 series. The devices receiving the One UI 9 beta update are the Galaxy S23, Galaxy S23+, Galaxy S23 Ultra, Galaxy Z Fold7, Galaxy Z Flip7, Galaxy Z Fold6, Galaxy Z Flip6, Galaxy A57, and Galaxy A56. The tenth device is the Galaxy S24 FE, which was left out from the rollout initially. Overall, One UI 9.0 doesn't really bring anything seriously new to the table. title: Xiaomi 18 Fold with XRING O3 chip showcased at IFA 2026, we go eyes on
description: Xiaomi is set to launch its 18 Fold next week, and we got to check it out at IFA 2026 ahead of its unveiling. Spoiler alert: the device was placed behind glass, so we could not actually get our hands on it, but we did get to marvel at its design, and the first thing that struck us was that bright red color. It certainly pops and is a lot more vibrant in person than some of the earlier shots we saw online. Moving on to the actual design, the 18 Fold adopts the short and wide “passport” look, which made headlines with the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8, and we certainly dig this form...

title: vivo X500’s camera specifications officially revealed
description: The vivo X500 series, comprising the base X500, X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max, is set to launch in China this month. While vivo has already shared several details about the Pro models, the company has now revealed the camera specs of the standard X500. According to vivo, the vivo X500 will feature the same primary camera sensor as the current vivo X300 Pro. It will use a 50MP 1/1.28-inch Sony LYT-828 sensor. The primary rear camera will also feature Zeiss gimbal-level stabilization and carry a CIPA 5.5 professional stabilization rating. For telephoto photography, the X500 will use...

title: Mivi to enter Indian smartphone market this month with the launch of Mivi One 5G
description: Last month, Indian electronics brand Fire-Boltt entered the Indian smartphone market with the launch of the Boltt Ace 5G and Boltt Evo 4G smartphones. This month, another Indian electronics brand, Mivi, will enter the Indian smartphone market with its first smartphone, the Mivi One 5G. The Mivi One 5G will be powered by a Snapdragon chip and will be sold online exclusively through Flipkart. title: Here’s what the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max could look like
description: We’ve heard plenty about the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max in recent weeks. The flagship is said to launch in China this month with a triple 200MP rear camera setup. Ahead of any official announcement, leaked renders of the phone have now surfaced. The leaked renders, shared by tipster Fixed Focus Digital, show a redesigned rear camera module that now stretches across the width of the device. It’s somewhat similar to the iPhone 17 Pro’s camera plateau. However, the Find X10 Pro Max features a second square module positioned within the larger rectangular camera island. The inner module...

title: Huawei Watch GT 7 Pro in for review
description: This is the Huawei Watch GT 7 Pro in Pine Green, and we’re taking a closer look at it ahead of our full review. Let’s start with the unboxing experience. Huawei is still using its proprietary magnetic charging puck, which is wired to a USB-A cable. That’s the only accessory you get in the package. We were hoping for a detachable USB-C connector by now, but there’s always next year. The overall design of the GT 7 Pro is quite similar to the GT 6 Pro, though there are some subtle changes. The first one is the new screen bezel, which is color-matched to the watch strap. Speaking...

title: Huawei MatePad Pro 12 (2026) goes global
description: Huawei held a big event in Munich where we got to see its latest wearables as well as the global debut of the nova16s series smartphones. But those weren’t the only devices to take the stage, as the MatePad Pro 12 (2026) also made its global debut. The tablet was announced in China last month and brings 12-inch OLED with 3,036 × 1,952px resolution, a 144Hz refresh rate and 1,600 nits peak brightness. Huawei is also offering a PaperMatte Display version of the tablet, which features an anti-glare coating. Huawei is also offering two optional accessories with the M-Pencil Pro stylus and...

title: Huawei nova 16s Pro goes global with 200MP RYYB camera, nova 16s joins it
description: Huawei introduced the nova 16 and 16 Pro to the Chinese market at the start of June. These two are now ready for their global debut, kind of – as has become the norm for the company, the global versions get an “s” tagged on to their name. The Huawei nova 16s Pro preserves the Pro’s highlight – a 200MP RYYB sensor for the main camera (f/1.8 lens with OIS). This is helped out by a 1.5MP multi-spectral sensor for scene-specific color calibration. Also on the back are a 50MP RYYB 3.7x periscope (f/2.6 lens with OIS) and a 50MP RYYB ultra-wide (118° FoV, 2.5cm macro mode). The selfie camera...

title: Huawei Watch 6 series announced, Watch GT 7 and GT 7 Pro go global
description: Huawei unveiled its latest smartwatches with the Watch 6 and Watch 6 Pro slotting in as the new flagship wearables from the brand. They are joined by the Watch GT 7 and Watch GT 7 Pro which were previously announced in China as well as the Watch D3 and FreeBuds Neo with the latter two covered in a separate post. Huawei Watch 6 and 6 Pro The Huawei Watch 6 series consists of two members with the Watch 6 and Watch 6 Pro. The vanilla Watch 6 arrives in 42 and 46mm sizes, while the Pro is offered in 43 and 46mm casings. The 42mm Watch 6 comes in at just 38 grams (without the strap), making...

title: Huawei Watch D3 and FreeBuds Neo debut
description: The Watch 6 and Watch GT 7 series are Huawei’s mainstream smartwatches, but the brand also introduced the latest addition to its health-focused Watch D series with the Watch D3. It brings medical-grade blood pressure monitoring, an updated design with а larger and brighter display. Alongside its new wrist wearables, Huawei also announced a new pair of wireless earbuds dubbed FreeBuds Neo. Huawei Watch D3 On the outside, Watch D3 looks a lot like its predecessor, though Huawei managed to slim the aluminum chassis down to 11.3 mm while keeping the weight at 40 grams. Huawei...

title: Samsung is building Exynos 2700-powered Galaxy S27 Ultras, insiders claim
description: Samsung may be changing course at the 11th hour – development of the Galaxy S27 Ultra is nearly complete, but now insiders are saying that the company will dual-source chipsets for the new flagship. The original plan was for the S27 Ultra to use the top Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chip in all markets. However, following encouraging internal benchmarks, the Exynos 2700 has become a viable option for the 2027 flagship. title: The Huawei MatePad Air (2026) is launching in China next week, may bring some upgrades
description: Reversing the traditional dynamic, the Huawei MatePad Air (2026) was announced for the global market back in July and will only launch in China next week on September 7 (Monday). This will happen at the event for the tri-folding Huawei Mate XT 2. The Huawei MatePad Air (2026) is launching in China next week The MatePad Air (2026) is a 12” tablet with a 144Hz OLED display – a 3:2 2,800 x 1,840px panel. description: Samsung expanded the Android 17-based One UI 9 Beta program to six Galaxy devices yesterday, including Galaxy Z Fold7, Galaxy Z Flip7, Galaxy S25, Galaxy S25+, Galaxy S25 Ultra, and Galaxy S25 FE. It also released the One UI 9 beta update for the Galaxy S25 series yesterday. Now, in a surprising move, the Korean company has rolled out One UI 9 beta for the Galaxy S24 series as well.
